data.name: Fire Breath
data.description: As a standard action, you can unleash a 15-foot cone of flame from your mouth. This flame deals %1d4 points of fire damage. A Reflex save halves this damage. You can use this ability %2 times per day. The save DC is Charisma-based.|classlevel("Oracle")|1+(classlevel("Oracle")/5)
